item.title: FOX 21 broadcasting on low power; Cable and satellite systems okay
item.description: Damage to FOX 21 Broadcast Tower (FOX 21) – Our over-the-air signal is low right now. Ice build-up from the recent storms has begun falling off our tower and damaging some of the equipment below. It is too dangerous to fix those parts until the ice has stopped falling. Cable and satellite systems should be fine.
